2609.10722.title: CMNIE: An Information Extraction Benchmark for Chinese Military News
2609.10722.paper_summary: Structured extraction from Chinese military news supports intelligence analysis, decision-making, and knowledge base construction. However, existing resources provide limited support for joint informa?tion extraction in this domain, especially when events, event arguments, entities, and relations must be modeled together. We present CMNIE, an information extraction benchmark for Chinese military news. Extend?ing military-domain resources beyond document-level event annotations, CMNIE jointly annotates event triggers, event arguments, named enti?ties, and entity relations under a unified domain schema. The dataset contains 13,000 instances collected from public Chinese military news, with manual annotations for 7 event types, 10 argument roles, 7 entity types, and 8 relation types. We evaluate supervised IE models, zero-shot large language models, and fine-tuned LLM-based extraction methods on a shared test set. Experimental results show that CMNIE remains chal?lenging, especially for relation extraction and exact matching of event?argument spans; zero-shot LLMs often identify relevant semantic units but fail to match gold span boundaries exactly. CMNIE provides a stan?dardized benchmark for studying schema adherence, exact span match?ing, and joint structured extraction in specialized Chinese news.
2609.10722.paper_summary_zh: 結構化的中國軍事新聞提取支持情報分析、決策制定和知識庫建設。然而，現有資源對於該領域的聯合信息提取提供的支持有限，特別是在事件、事件參數、實體和關係必須共同建模的情況下。我們提出了CMNIE，一個針對中國軍事新聞的信息提取基準。CMNIE在文檔級事件註釋之外擴展了軍事領域資源，統一地註釋事件觸發器、事件參數、命名實體和實體關係。該數據集包含從公共中國軍事新聞中收集的13,000個實例，並對7種類型的事件、10種參數角色、7種類型的實體和8種類型的關係進行了手動註釋。我們在共享測試集上評估了監督式IE模型、零樣本大型語言模型和微調的基於LLM的提取方法。實驗結果顯示，CMNIE仍然具有挑戰性，特別是在關係提取和事件參數範圍的精確匹配方面；零樣本LLM通常能識別相關的語義單位，但無法精確匹配金標範圍的邊界。CMNIE為研究模式遵循、精確範圍匹配和專業中國新聞中的聯合結構提取提供了一個標準化的基準。
